summary.text: Student life at IIT Bombay is run largely by the Students' Gymkhana through six councils covering hostels, sports, culture, technology and academics, with a wide spread of clubs and tech teams beneath them. The Powai campus hosts three flagship fests — Mood Indigo (cultural), Techfest (technical) and E-Summit (entrepreneurship) — plus the Aavhan sports fest, while inter-hostel General Championships keep hostel rivalries alive through the year.
